title: CobbleForDays Legacy
body:
CobbleForDays Legacy is [CobbleForDays](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblefordays) 1.12.2 ports.

Adds five tiers of cobblestone generators.


Each generator automatically produces cobblestone and stores it internally.

Players can right‑click to extract cobblestone, and breaking the block preserves its stored inventory.

Higher‑tier generators offer increased maximum storage, higher output per cycle, and faster production speeds.

Tiers 3 and above automatically push cobblestone upward into containers placed above.

All parameters—including storage capacity, output amount, production interval, and auto‑push behavior—are fully configurable through the configuration file.
